description: MAD-WRF's hydrometeor tracers (madwrf_opt = 2): advected and diffused copies of the initial qc, qi and qs that the step nudges the active hydrometeors toward.

rows.name: tr_qc
rows.provenance: WRF v4.7.1 Registry.EM_COMMON:3072, package madwrf (madwrf_opt==2) tracer:tr_qc,tr_qi,tr_qs: set equal to qc by real.exe's Init_madwrf_tracers (module_initialize_real.F:4868-4874; woof seeds it at the cold start) and advected and diffused as a WRF tracer; zero inflow (flow_dep_bdy). Read by Cloud_tracer_nudge (woof/core/madwrf.py).
